recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-32509 unless a future review separately audits the other Procedure issues that shared the original implementation commit.
issue_request: FHIR-32509 is a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request asking to remove an extraneous 'or' from the Procedure.reason definition, changing 'This may be a coded entity of some type, or may simply be present as text, or may be...' to 'This may be a coded entity of some type, be present as text, or be...' for R5 as a non-substantive clarification.
initial_application: The Jira comment links implementation commit 9241c2d467b808407f77b86ac99a9577979ab7ce, which changed source/procedure/structuredefinition-Procedure.xml to the requested wording. Later source maintenance commit 086649a2357c29f8c83dca7604dc592d32c84355 carried the same corrected definition into source/procedure/procedure-event-mapping-exceptions.xml.
additional_context: Procedure is active in source/fhir.ini and marked approved. Current Procedure source and the Procedure event-mapping exception source both use the corrected phrase. Community searches found no Zulip discussion changing the conclusion; Confluence refs found the Patient Care 2022-08-18 minutes page referencing FHIR-32509 but no conflicting guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. An empty no-change audit commit was published because the current build source already reflects the FHIR-32509 correction and no non-SVG source occurrence of the old wording remains.
